title: Knowledge Representation & Reasoning
subtitle: Logika Proposisional, First-Order Logic, Mesin Inferensi (Forward & Backward Chaining), dan Sistem Pakar
description: Bangun sistem penalaran logis melalui formalisasi Knowledge Representation dan mesin inferensi terstruktur. Chapter ini menghubungkan logika proposisional, First-Order Logic, aturan Modus Ponens, serta mekanisme Forward dan Backward Chaining.
objectives: Menjelaskan peran Knowledge Representation dalam Artificial Intelligence.
Membedakan facts, rules, knowledge base, dan inference.
Merepresentasikan pengetahuan sederhana menggunakan Propositional Logic.
Membedakan Forward Chaining dan Backward Chaining.
Mengidentifikasi keterbatasan symbolic reasoning pada informasi tidak lengkap atau ambigu.

references.title: Russell, S., & Norvig, P. (2020). Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (4th ed.). Pearson. Bab 7: Logical Agents & Bab 9: Inference in First-Order Logic.
Brachman, R., & Levesque, H. (2004). Knowledge Representation and Reasoning. Morgan Kaufmann.
ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI (2024). Computer Science Curricula 2023 (CS2023): AI Knowledge Area.

highlights: Perbedaan facts, rules, knowledge base, dan mekanisme inferensi.
Representasi pengetahuan formal memakai Propositional dan First-Order Logic.
Penerapan tabel kebenaran, entailment, dan aturan inferensi Modus Ponens.
Perbandingan strategi inferensi Forward Chaining dan Backward Chaining.
Implementasi mesin pakar sederhana berbasis aturan di Python.
